ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_DUPLICATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_duplicate (temp_value in VARCHAR2,
 temp_field in VARCHAR2,temp_v_unit_sch in VARCHAR2) is
 save_record VARCHAR2(3);
begin
 save_record := :system.trigger_record;
 first_record;
 loop
 if temp_value = name_in(temp_field)
 AND temp_v_unit_sch = :unit_scheme_type
 and :system.cursor_record != save_record
 then
 go_record(save_record);
 GO_ITEM(:system.trigger_field);
 show_error_dist('0319');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end if;
 end loop;
 go_record(save_record);
 GO_ITEM(temp_field);
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMMIT_TRANSACTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure commit_transaction is
-- this procedure commits all changes and display order number that has
-- been generated
begin
 if :system.form_status = 'CHANGED'
 then
 :system.message_level := 5;
 check_pass;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_success
 then
 show_error_dist('0000'); /* transaction committed */
 check_package_failure;
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 show_error_dist('0600'); /* unsuccessful commit */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 else
 show_error_dist('0601'); /* no change to commit */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXPIRED
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
function expired ( in_date in date, out_date out date)
 return boolean is
 temp_date date;
begin
 nullchk;
 if in_date >= sysdate
 then
 out_date := in_date;
 return FALSE;
 else
 select to_date(to_char(in_date,'mm-dd-yy'),'mm-dd-rr')
 into out_date from dual;
 if out_date >= sysdate
 then
 return FALSE;
 else
 show_error_dist('3701'); /* product expired */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 return TRUE;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUPLI_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* This Procedure Checks Out Duplicate Records while entering...
 ABO LABEL 30-Jan-97 
*/
PROCEDURE dupli_check IS
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 temp_v_abo_code varchar2(5);
 temp_v_unit_scheme_type varchar2(1);
 temp_v_item_name varchar2(50);
 temp_c_rec_no VARCHAR2(2);
 BEGIN
 temp_v_abo_code := :abo_code;
 temp_v_unit_scheme_type := :unit_scheme_type;
 temp_v_item_name := :system.cursor_item;
 temp_c_rec_no := :system.trigger_record;
 go_record('1');
 WHILE :system.last_record = 'FALSE'
 LOOP
 IF :abo_code = temp_v_abo_code AND
 :system.trigger_record != temp_c_rec_no AND
 :unit_scheme_type = temp_v_unit_scheme_type
 THEN
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
 show_error_dist('0319');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 down;
 END LOOP;
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_code number;
 temp_msg VARCHAR2(80);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error_dist('0213');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error_dist('0214');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error_dist('0216');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error_dist('0204');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error_dist('0217');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error_dist('0218');
 elsif error_code = 40209 -- invalid entry format
 then
 show_error_dist('0246');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error_dist('0000');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0601');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026,0)
 then
 declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(20);
 begin
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2))='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error_dist('0251',disp_format_mask);
 show_error_dist('0251',GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 end;
 elsif error_code = 50025 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0509');
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error_dist('0220');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error_dist('0331');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;
 else -- unhandled Forms errors
 message('FRMS ' || to_char(error_code) || ':' || error_text);
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;
